title: Black Queen Hypothesis and its Dependencies
summary: The Black Queen Hypothesis is a process or phenomenon that has adaptive gene loss as a dependency. It also has dependencies on various entities, including a scientific article (10.1111 / j.1462 - 2920.2006.00989.x), researchers (Dolfing J, Eekert MHA van, Plugge CM, and Schraa G), a journal (Environ Microbiol), and other processes or phenomena (anaerobic microbial communities and Exocellular electron transfer).
